name: initKolHaamPhase3Tables
sql: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='author_profiles'
ALTER TABLE author_profiles ADD COLUMN ${col} ${def}
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='content_engagement_metrics'
ALTER TABLE content_engagement_metrics ADD COLUMN peak_score_first_week NUMERIC(12,4) DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE author_profiles DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS author_profiles_badge_level_check
ALTER TABLE author_profiles ADD CONSTRAINT author_profiles_badge_level_check CHECK (badge_level IN ('DEFAULT','LOCAL_LEADER','GLOBAL_LEADER','LEGACY'))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS achievement_types ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, key VARCHAR(60) UNIQUE NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, description TEXT, icon VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '🏆', flow_reward INT DEFAULT 0, scope VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'local', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS author_achievements ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, author_profile_id INT REFERENCES author_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, achievement_type_id INT REFERENCES achievement_types(id), content_item_id INT REFERENCES content_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, earned_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(author_profile_id, achievement_type_id, content_item_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS author_followers ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, follower_group_id INT NOT NULL, following_profile_id INT REFERENCES author_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(follower_group_id, following_profile_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS editor_picks ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, content_item_id INT REFERENCES content_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, note TEXT, pinned_until DATE, created_by_sa VARCHAR(120), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_flow_rewards ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, author_profile_id INT REFERENCES author_profiles(id), content_item_id INT REFERENCES content_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, reward_reason VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL, awarded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() )
INSERT INTO achievement_types (key, title, description, icon, flow_reward, scope) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET title=$2, description=$3, icon=$4, flow_reward=$5

name: runPhase3DailyCron
sql: UPDATE content_engagement_metrics cem SET peak_score_first_week = GREATEST(COALESCE(cem.peak_score_first_week,0), COALESCE(cem.current_trending_score,0)) FROM content_items ci WHERE cem.content_item_id = ci.id AND ci.published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBLISHED_GLOBAL')

SELECT ci.id, ci.author_profile_id, ci.status, cem.peak_score_first_week, ap.badge_level, ap.local_streak_count, ap.global_streak_count FROM content_items ci JOIN content_engagement_metrics cem ON cem.content_item_id=ci.id JOIN author_profiles ap ON ap.id=ci.author_profile_id WHERE ci.published_at BETWEEN NOW()-INTERVAL '8 days' AND NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' AND ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBL …
UPDATE author_profiles SET badge_level=$1, badge_achieved_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2
UPDATE author_profiles SET global_streak_count=$1 WHERE id=$2
UPDATE author_profiles SET local_streak_count=$1 WHERE id=$2

UPDATE author_profiles ap SET badge_level='LEGACY' WHERE ap.badge_level IN ('LOCAL_LEADER','GLOBAL_LEADER') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_items ci WHERE ci.author_profile_id=ap.id AND ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBLISHED_GLOBAL') AND ci.published_at >= NOW()-INTERVAL '60 days' )
UPDATE author_profiles SET is_revoked=FALSE, revoked_until=NULL WHERE is_revoked=TRUE AND revoked_until IS NOT NULL AND revoked_until <= NOW()

name: runPhase3WeeklyCron
sql: SELECT ci.id, ci.author_profile_id FROM content_items ci JOIN content_engagement_metrics cem ON cem.content_item_id=ci.id WHERE ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBLISHED_GLOBAL') AND ci.published_at >= NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY cem.peak_score_first_week DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.id, ci.author_profile_id, COUNT(csl.id) as share_cnt FROM content_items ci LEFT JOIN content_shares_log csl ON csl.content_item_id=ci.id AND csl.shared_at >= NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBLISHED_GLOBAL') GROUP BY ci.id, ci.author_profile_id ORDER BY share_cnt DESC LIMIT 1

name: runPhase3MonthlyCron
sql: SELECT ci.id, ci.author_profile_id FROM content_items ci JOIN content_engagement_metrics cem ON cem.content_item_id=ci.id WHERE ci.status IN ('PUBLISHED_LOCAL','PUBLISHED_GLOBAL') AND ci.published_at >= NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY cem.peak_score_first_week DESC LIMIT 1
